name: Sasaki Takami
source:
Takami is the representative of [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s class. She is known for being a little sharp and blunt, but there are rare times when she exhibits a lack of confidence. She was very kind to Yousuke after his father died, and she did her best to help him keep up in class. She is stern with him, but that only shows that she cares about him.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/565978-tsuki-possession/faqs/28692]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and Erogereview]
